scenes.title_cn: 四大能力与内容力新规
scenes.title_en: Four Abilities and the New Rules
scenes.context: 作者宣称 2023 年建立四大能力体系，2026 年 5 月 17 日平台推出内容力新规。
sentences: 我教的所有方法全部在平台上得到验证。
Every method I teach has been proven on the platform.
proven（被验证）
我们的个人体系是四大能力。
My personal system is built on four core abilities.
core abilities（核心能力）
2026年5月17号平台推出新规，考核内容力。
On May 17, 2026, the platform rolled out new rules assessing content power.
assess（考核）
paraphrase: The presentation of people, product, and scene.
We taught it before the platform required it.
scenes.speak: Every method I teach has been proven on the platform. My personal system is built on four core abilities. On May 17, 2026, the platform rolled out new rules assessing content power.

scenes.title_en: Hard Demands on Visuals and Scripts
scenes.context: 画质不能同质化/绿幕/AI/不清晰；话术不能太营销，卖点要场景化情绪化。
sentences: 画质画面不能同质化、不能绿幕、不能是 AI。
Visuals must not be homogenized, green-screen, or AI-generated.
homogenized（同质化）
画质画面不能不清晰，否则会影响推流。
Unclear visuals hurt your traffic, so keep it sharp.
push traffic（推流）
话术不能太营销。
The script can't sound too salesy.
salesy（营销味重）
paraphrase: Present the selling point in a real-life scene.
Package content to go viral with traffic hooks.
scenes.speak: Visuals must not be homogenized, green-screen, or AI-generated. Unclear visuals hurt your traffic, so keep it sharp. The script can't sound too salesy.

scenes.context: 教知识、验货测评、才艺展示、慢动作展示、讲故事，都是有自然流属性的内容。
sentences: 要做有自然流属性的内容。
Create content with organic-traffic appeal.
organic traffic（自然流）
要变成教知识、验货测评。
Turn it into teaching and product unboxing.
unboxing（验货测评）
平台要求一定要有活人感。
The platform requires a real human touch.
human touch（活人感）
paraphrase: Show a talent or craft on stream.
Sell through a short story, not a pitch.
scenes.speak: Create content with organic-traffic appeal. Turn it into teaching and product unboxing. The platform requires a real human touch.

scenes.context: 全域流量下观众多只有购买意向，直接卖货会流失；先教知识留人再转化。
sentences: 人家只是有购买意向，不是购买行为。
They have purchase intent, not a purchase action.
purchase intent（购买意向）
你直接卖他东西，他一定会走。
Sell to them outright, and they'll leave for sure.
outright（直接地）
先做内容让他围观，然后再卖货。
Hook them with content first, then sell.
hook（留住/吸引）
paraphrase: Give a mini lesson, then make the pitch.
This is clearly where it's heading.
scenes.speak: They have purchase intent, not a purchase action. Sell to them outright, and they'll leave for sure. Hook them with content first, then sell.

practice: 新规对画质画面有哪些要求？
No homogenization, no green screen, no AI, and must be sharp.
话术去营销化是什么意思？
Frame selling points in real scenes and emotions instead of hard-selling.
自然流围观内容有哪些形式？
Teaching, unboxing reviews, talent shows, slow-mo demos, and stories.
Most viewers have intent, not action — selling outright drives them away.
pitfalls: Use green screens and AI visuals.
Keep the scene real and clear.
The new rules explicitly reject homogenized and AI visuals.
Teach or show value before pitching.
Direct selling drives away viewers with only purchase intent.
Copy the same template as everyone else.
Build your own real, human style.
Differentiation and a human touch are what the rules reward.
Ignore the change and keep old scripts.
The creator argues this structure is the trend.
shifts: 以前直播间直接硬卖货
现在先做自然流围观内容再转化
现在卖点场景化、情绪化表达
现在真实、清晰、有活人感
